say:1:1720954001:1.text: You got here fast, Magister Merlin. What's wrong?
say:1:1720954001:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，您匆匆赶来，是有什么事吗？
say:1:1720954001:1.male: You got here fast, Magister Merlin. What's wrong?
say:1:1720954001:1.female: You got here fast, Magister Merlin. What's wrong?

say:2:1720954002:1.text: You tell Hendrik everything. The Savannah Eye, the lies it spreads, the investigation, and everything you found in Viscount Demit's manor.
say:2:1720954002:1.source_cn: 你将《赛凡纳之眼》的阴谋、调查过程、以及在德米特子爵府...
say:2:1720954002:1.male: You tell Hendrik everything. The Savannah Eye, the lies it spreads, the investigation, and everything you found in Viscount Demit's manor.
say:2:1720954002:1.female: You tell Hendrik everything. The Savannah Eye, the lies it spreads, the investigation, and everything you found in Viscount Demit's manor.

say:3:1720954003:1.text: The more he hears, the grimmer he looks.
say:3:1720954003:1.source_cn: 听着你的调查结果，亨德里克的面色逐渐凝重。
say:3:1720954003:1.male: The more he hears, the grimmer he looks.
say:3:1720954003:1.female: The more he hears, the grimmer he looks.

say:4:1720954004:1.text: So that's what was going on. Those rumors about the queen and the princess didn't just catch on by themselves. Someone had been spreading them on purpose from the start.
say:4:1720954004:1.source_cn: 原来如此，市井间那些针对王后与公主的流言，背后竟是如此...
say:4:1720954004:1.male: So that's what was going on. Those rumors about the queen and the princess didn't just catch on by themselves. Someone had been spreading them on purpose from the start.
say:4:1720954004:1.female: So that's what was going on. Those rumors about the queen and the princess didn't just catch on by themselves. Someone had been spreading them on purpose from the start.

say:5:1720954005:1.text: That's it. I'm sending men after Demit right now.
say:5:1720954005:1.source_cn: 我现在就下令，全力拘捕德米特子爵。
say:5:1720954005:1.male: That's it. I'm sending men after Demit right now.
say:5:1720954005:1.female: That's it. I'm sending men after Demit right now.

say:6:1720954006:1.text: You finally let yourself relax, certain the viscount's arrest is only a matter of time. But before long, the guard sent to carry out the operation returns with unexpected news—
say:6:1720954006:1.source_cn: 你放下心来，等待着子爵的落网。然而，没过多久，负责执行...
say:6:1720954006:1.male: You finally let yourself relax, certain the viscount's arrest is only a matter of time. But before long, the guard sent to carry out the operation returns with unexpected news—
say:6:1720954006:1.female: You finally let yourself relax, certain the viscount's arrest is only a matter of time. But before long, the guard sent to carry out the operation returns with unexpected news—

say:8:1720954007:1.text: Commander, we have a problem. Viscount Demit is gone!
say:8:1720954007:1.source_cn: 司令，不好！德米特子爵他……他失踪了！
say:8:1720954007:1.male: Commander, we have a problem. Viscount Demit is gone!
say:8:1720954007:1.female: Commander, we have a problem. Viscount Demit is gone!

say:9:1720954008:1.text: We searched all over the city. Nothing. It's like he disappeared the moment he left the manor!
say:9:1720954008:1.source_cn: 我们的人把全城都搜遍了，但是德米特子爵就像人间蒸发一样...
say:9:1720954008:1.male: We searched all over the city. Nothing. It's like he disappeared the moment he left the manor!
say:9:1720954008:1.female: We searched all over the city. Nothing. It's like he disappeared the moment he left the manor!

say:10:1720954009:1.text: And the paper's gone too. Not a single copy of the Savannah Eye anywhere!
say:10:1720954009:1.source_cn: 不仅如此，那份报纸……《赛凡纳之眼》也在街头巷尾销声匿迹了！
say:10:1720954009:1.male: And the paper's gone too. Not a single copy of the Savannah Eye anywhere!
say:10:1720954009:1.female: And the paper's gone too. Not a single copy of the Savannah Eye anywhere!

choice_prompt:11:1720954009.female: And the paper's gone too. Not a single copy of the Savannah Eye anywhere!

say:12:1720954010:1.text: I saw that coming. That's why I had the gates locked down. Anyone entering or leaving the city is being searched. He's still in Savannah. He has to be.
say:12:1720954010:1.source_cn: 我也这么认为。早先我已经下令严加看守城门，所有出入赛凡...
say:12:1720954010:1.male: I saw that coming. That's why I had the gates locked down. Anyone entering or leaving the city is being searched. He's still in Savannah. He has to be.
say:12:1720954010:1.female: I saw that coming. That's why I had the gates locked down. Anyone entering or leaving the city is being searched. He's still in Savannah. He has to be.

say:13:1720954011:1.text: And this happened too fast. Demit couldn't have done all this by himself. Whoever's backing him is already making their move.
say:13:1720954011:1.source_cn: 能如此迅速地有所动作，抹去所有踪迹……他背后那股势力，...
say:13:1720954011:1.male: And this happened too fast. Demit couldn't have done all this by himself. Whoever's backing him is already making their move.
say:13:1720954011:1.female: And this happened too fast. Demit couldn't have done all this by himself. Whoever's backing him is already making their move.

choice_prompt:14:1720954011.text: And this happened too fast. Demit couldn't have done all this by himself. Whoever's backing him is already making their move.
choice_prompt:14:1720954011.source_cn: 能如此迅速地有所动作，抹去所有踪迹……他背后那股势力，亲自出手了。
choice_prompt:14:1720954011.male: And this happened too fast. Demit couldn't have done all this by himself. Whoever's backing him is already making their move.
choice_prompt:14:1720954011.female: And this happened too fast. Demit couldn't have done all this by himself. Whoever's backing him is already making their move.

say:15:1720954012:1.text: If it was them, that would explain it. They've got money, muscle, and places to hide people all over the city.
say:15:1720954012:1.source_cn: 黑金商会……如果是他们，确实有这个能力。他们在赛凡纳盘...
say:15:1720954012:1.male: If it was them, that would explain it. They've got money, muscle, and places to hide people all over the city.
say:15:1720954012:1.female: If it was them, that would explain it. They've got money, muscle, and places to hide people all over the city.

say:16:1720954013:1.text: There's a Syndicate storefront in the lower district, back in the alleys where all the filthiest business gets done.
say:16:1720954013:1.source_cn: 据我所知，下城区最为鱼龙混杂的暗巷里，就有一家黑金商铺。
say:16:1720954013:1.male: There's a Syndicate storefront in the lower district, back in the alleys where all the filthiest business gets done.
say:16:1720954013:1.female: There's a Syndicate storefront in the lower district, back in the alleys where all the filthiest business gets done.

say:18:1720954014:1.text: Wouldn't surprise me. If a man wanted to disappear without leaving the city, that's exactly the kind of hole he'd crawl into. Looks like we're going ourselves.
say:18:1720954014:1.source_cn: 有这个可能。对需要躲藏的人来说，那里会是最安全的地方。...
say:18:1720954014:1.male: Wouldn't surprise me. If a man wanted to disappear without leaving the city, that's exactly the kind of hole he'd crawl into. Looks like we're going ourselves.
say:18:1720954014:1.female: Wouldn't surprise me. If a man wanted to disappear without leaving the city, that's exactly the kind of hole he'd crawl into. Looks like we're going ourselves.

choice:17:0:1.text: You think they're hiding Demit there?
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 德米特会不会就藏在那里？
choice:17:0:1.male: You think they're hiding Demit there?
choice:17:0:1.female: You think they're hiding Demit there?

choice:11:0:1.text: He knew it was over, so he ran.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 他察觉到阴谋败露，潜逃了
choice:11:0:1.male: He knew it was over, so he ran.
choice:11:0:1.female: He knew it was over, so he ran.

choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 他背后的势力在清扫痕迹
